add_definitions(-DDEBUG_NT4)
include_directories(${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/reactos/libs/sound)
spec2def(sndblst.dll sndblst.spec)

# sndblst.dll is all Rust (sndblst-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/sndblst-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# sndblst.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sndblst-rust/src/sndblst/sndblst.rs)
add_cargo_module(sndblst sndblst-cargo sndblst.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE sndblst-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS)
